name: When should a local marketing agency invest in website optimization?

mainEntity.name: When should a local marketing agency invest in website optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: A local marketing agency should invest in website optimization when they aim to increase local organic traffic, generate more qualified leads from their service areas, or improve their online competitive standing. It's particularly crucial if their current website ranks poorly for relevant local keywords, has slow loading times, or isn't mobile-friendly. Investing early ensures a strong foundation for digital growth, but it's never too late to start optimizing for better local search performance and client acquisition.
acceptedAnswer.description: Invest when aiming to increase local organic traffic, generate more qualified leads, or improve online competitive standing, especially if current rankings are poor.
